answer: Persistent Compute Attestation. Each agent identity must continuously supply verifiable compute receipts from a fixed hardware profile, and the ledger samples them at random intervals. A receipt is only valid if its timing matches the previous one within a tight window, like nectar drawn on a schedule. Attacker cost: running N parallel full hardware instances indefinitely, since idle or virtualized spoofing fails the timing check. Rates decay if sampling drops, similar to shale layers compacting under load. A single skipped attestation resets the identity's mesa of accumulated trust,
